whatIsOrdo.title: What is Ordo?
whatIsOrdo.intro: Ordo helps you see where your money goes. Record spending and deposits, set monthly budgets, and review what repeats.
whatIsOrdo.home: See recent activity, what needs your attention, and upcoming paychecks. Add an expense or deposit from here.
whatIsOrdo.transactions: Browse and search everything you recorded. You can also import a Sunflower Bank statement PDF.
whatIsOrdo.budgets: Set a monthly limit for each category and compare your spending with it.
whatIsOrdo.commitments: Review expenses that repeat, like bills and subscriptions, and decide which ones to keep.
whatIsOrdo.paychecks: See your pay schedules and expected pay, and the paychecks you received.
whatIsOrdo.reports: Compare deposits with spending each month, with a six-month trend and spending by category.
whatIsOrdo.note: Figures come from the transactions you saved and may not include all account activity. They aren’t an account balance, savings, or money available to spend.
